description: This file defines utility functions for managing promises, including creating, inspecting, waiting on, and combining promises within the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace. It provides static methods for common promise operations such as all, race, settle, and unwrapping promises.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for promise management such as creating task queues, running tasks, inspecting promises, and aggregating multiple promises.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Returns the global task queue used for promise resolution, optionally allowing assignment of a new queue.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Adds a specified callable task to the queue and returns a promise that resolves when the task completes.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Synchronously waits for a promise to resolve and returns an array indicating its state and result or reason.

methods.name: inspectAll
methods.description: Inspects all promises in an iterable and returns an array of their states.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Waits on all provided promises and returns their fulfilled values. Throws if any promise is rejected.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills when all input promises are fulfilled, with an array of their fulfillment values. Rejects if any promise rejects.

methods.name: some
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled when a specified number of input promises are fulfilled, or rejects if insufficient promises fulfill.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with the value of the first fulfilled input promise.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with an array of inspection states, indicating whether each promise was fulfilled or rejected.
